premises.text: Customers struggle to book last-minute personal services while qualified small businesses have idle capacity and want new paying customers
premises.evidence_span: I had to go through the painful process of dialing all of those merchants just to find one that was willing to take my money

premises.text: Customers place service requests with named price, travel, timing, and minimum rating; Bidzee offers the bid to local merchants
premises.evidence_span: you can easily place a request for personal service, and you can even name your own price

premises.text: Merchants accept bids from their app when they have capacity; acceptance charges the customer card and schedules both calendars
premises.evidence_span: When this merchant hits accept, my credit card is immediately charged and the service is scheduled on both of our calendars

premises.text: Merchant acquisition is free of upfront cost, with bottom-of-funnel carded demand, timing certainty, and accept-only-when-idle capacity control
premises.evidence_span: A merchant working with BidZ faces no upfront investment at all

premises.text: Marketplace connects consumers only to verified, rated local businesses rather than peer consumers
premises.evidence_span: BidZ is only connecting you with a verified, rated local business in order to perform the service

value.text: Customers get services on their terms while merchants monetize idle time with paying customers
value.evidence_span: A customer gets an appointment on their terms, and a business gets a paying customer through the door

causal_links.evidence_span: get the service that I desperately need and put extra money in the pocket of this merchant
gives these merchants customer acquisition on their own terms
starting off with the key facet to a successful marketplace, trust

notes: Merchant pain list about existing channels folded into P4 as one merchant-side acquisition condition set. Service category list treated as scope of the same marketplace, not separate premises. Flip-the-equation uniqueness folded into P2 mechanism.
